audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows disagree with the packet and with their own whys: win[4]='Skill' beside whys[4] 'Level 6 is yours'; win[5]='Jayce' beside whys[5] 'First item is skill'; win[6]='Jayce' beside whys[6] '2+ items is yours'.
audit.why: Packet chart: Skill, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Wukong, Skill, Wukong. Win rate 53.16% over 713 games — Jayce owns the early poke phase and Wukong owns everything from the moment he can reach him.
audit.corrected: Rows 4, 5 and 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs, with ratings raised to 6/10 on the two rows Wukong now owns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page hangs Wukong's window on 'level 6', but Jayce levels six abilities on a different curve — his Q runs 16/14/12/10/8/6s and his E 20/18/16/14/12/10s across SIX ranks, so his poke tightens with skill points rather than with the 6th level itself.
audit.why: The jayce__wukong mirror records the same correction: 'Tie the window to his skill points, not to level 6.' Shock Blast at 16s rank 1 is a long hole; by late ranks it is 6s and there is no window at all.
audit.corrected: Shock Blast's 16s at rank 1 and Thundering Blow's 20s at rank 1 written into the spikes and the interactions box, so the reader counts the ability rather than the level.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three errors. (1) spikes[0] defines Shock Blast as a 'hammer-to-cannon Q + E knockback combo'. Shock Blast is the Cannon-stance Q; the combo that makes it dangerous is Acceleration Gate (Cannon E), not the hammer knockback. (2) spikes[0] and wants.you[0] describe Warrior Trickster as an 'untargetable window' and an 'untargetable dash-in'. The brief carries no Wukong kit, and W is not a dash under any reading — that is asserted mechanics with nothing behind it. (3) spikes[1] claims 'he can't cancel your ult with his short E knockback'; whether a knockback interrupts Cyclone is not answerable from either kit.
audit.why: Riot E text, Cannon stance: 'Deploys an Acceleration Gate... If Shock Blast is fired through the gate the missile speed, range, and damage will increase.' Riot E text, Hammer stance: 'Deals magic damage to an enemy and knocks them back a short distance', 240 range, 20s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Shock Blast fired through an Acceleration Gate gains missile speed, range and damage — stand off the gate line. Thundering Blow is 240 range on a 20s rank-1 cooldown, and it is his only answer once you are on him. No untargetability or interrupt claimed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two properties of the weapon swap appear nowhere: the swap itself is a 6-second cooldown, and Riot's R text says the FIRST ATTACK in Cannon form 'reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist'. Hextech Capacitor also grants move speed on every swap.
audit.why: The armour-and-MR shred on his swap attack is the tell that a burst combo is starting, and the move speed on swap is why he escapes gap-closes that look like they connected.
audit.corrected: The shred written into dontsFull[1].d as a swap tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shock Blast is named as the tracked cooldown in eleven places with no number.
audit.why: 16s at rank 1 falling to 6s at rank 6 is the entire arc of the lane — early it is punishable, late it is not.

edits.before: Jayce's Shock Blast (hammer-to-cannon Q + E knockback combo) can chunk a third of your health from range; use W's untargetable window to eat the poke and reset his zone control.
edits.after: Shock Blast is his Cannon Q, 16s at rank 1, and fired through an Acceleration Gate it gains missile speed, range and damage — that is the poke that chunks you. Stand off the gate line.

edits.before: Your R Cyclone is a hard counter to Jayce — he has no reliable escape once you Nimbus Strike (E) onto him, and he can't cancel your ult with his short E knockback.
edits.after: Your R Cyclone is a hard counter to Jayce — once you Nimbus Strike onto him his only answer is Thundering Blow, 240 range and 20s at rank 1, and after that he is out of tools.

edits.before: Dodge Shock Blast with W's untargetable dash-in
edits.after: Break the gate line, then clone his Shock Blast

edits.before: Use hammer E to knock you out of your R or Q range
edits.after: Thundering Blow to knock you off him, 20s at rank 1

edits.before: Track Jayce's Shock Blast: His main poke. Dodge/decoy it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1 — through his gate it gains range, speed and damage.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His first hammer-form hit cuts your armour and MR — swap tell.

notes: spikes[0] had Shock Blast's combo backwards — it called it a 'hammer-to-cannon Q + E knockback combo' when what makes it lethal is firing the Cannon Q through the Cannon E Acceleration Gate, which increases missile speed, range and damage. I also removed two unsupported Wukong claims: that Warrior Trickster is an 'untargetable window' and an 'untargetable dash-in' (the brief has no Wukong kit, and W is not a dash), and that Jayce 'can't cancel your ult with his short E knockback' (not answerable from either kit). Per the mirror's finding, the lane's timing is tied to Jayce's SKILL POINTS, not level 6 — his Q and E have six ranks, running 16s to 6s and 20s to 10s, so the punish window shrinks steadily rather than flipping at a level. NOT WRITTEN for lack of space: Mercury Cannon's first attack reduces your armour and MR, and Hextech Capacitor grants move speed on every weapon swap — the latter explains gap-closes that look like they connected and do not.
